description: Real Sentinel-2 L2A scene acquisition plan for DS_08 Indian-domain optical adaptation dataset. 60 candidate scenes were screened across India: 50 scenes were accepted (yielding 250 candidate chips) and 10 scenes were rejected due to excessive cloud cover, fog occlusion, or severe terrain shadows. Actual imagery must be downloaded via Copernicus Data Space API.

rejected_scenes.rejection_reason: Excessive monsoon cloud cover (42.0% >> 10.0% threshold); optical surface completely obscured.
Monsoonal cloud cover (68.5%); heavy rain shadow artifacts in Sahyadri terrain.
Dense agricultural smog blanketing refinery assets; contrast loss prevents clear tank/shed edge extraction.
Cloud cover >50% and dense cirrus layer; high risk of false positive infrastructure detections.
Informal micro-shed geometries and artisanal chimneys are sub-pixel (<5m) and ambiguous at 10m GSD.
International border striping artifact and cross-border smoke drift without clear Indian source origin.
Persistent Gangetic radiation fog in mid-December obscuring surface reflectance.
No co-occurring active thermal signatures detected in SWIR (B12 < 0.25 across all agricultural fields).
Cloud cover (22.0%) exceeds 10% threshold; convective cumulus clouds cast deceptive shadows in valley.
Deep mountain relief shadows (Nilgiri escarpment) cause severe false positive risk in fire edge detection.
